task.title: Exporting audio
task.shortdesc: Export a finished project as a WAV, MP3, OGG or FLAC file that other programs and devices can play.

prereq.p: Finish editing and save the project. A project file (.aup3) can only be opened by ; exporting creates an ordinary audio file.

choices.choice: Choose WAV or FLAC for an archive copy with no quality loss.
Choose MP3 or OGG for a small file to share.

info.p: For MP3, the bit rate controls the trade-off between size and quality.

stepxmp.p: A spoken-word podcast exports well at 128 kbps, Mono. Music needs 192 kbps or more, Stereo.

step.cmd: Choose a folder and a file name, then click Export.

steptroubleshooting.p: If the Export button is disabled, the file name is empty or the folder is read-only.

step.cmd: Fill in the Edit Metadata Tags dialog and click OK.

info.p: Title, artist and album are shown by most players.

result.p: The exported file is in the folder you chose. The project itself is unchanged.

example.title: Exporting a podcast episode
example.p: Choose MP3, set Bit Rate Mode to Constant, Quality to 128 kbps and Channel Mode to Force export to mono. A 30-minute episode exports to a file of about 27 MB.

link.desc: Clean up the recording before you export it.
